title: The Coffee Maker That Leaked
漏水的咖啡機
paras: Hannah had worked on the Kitchen Corner support line for three years, and she could tell from his first sentence that Mr. Silva was angry. "My coffee maker is two weeks old," he said. "It leaks all over the counter, and when it doesn't, it brews so {{poorly|poorly}} that the coffee tastes like water. It's {{defective|defective}}, and I want my money back."
漢娜在 Kitchen Corner 的客服專線工作了三年，光聽第一句話就知道席爾瓦先生在生氣。「我的咖啡機才買兩個星期，」他說，「它會漏得整個檯面都是水，不漏的時候，煮出來的咖啡又淡得像水。它有瑕疵，我要退錢。」

"I'm sorry about that," Hannah said. "Thank you for your {{patience|patience}} while I pull up your order." Mr. Silva sighed. "I've bought your brand for years, and it's always been {{dependable|dependable}}. That's why this makes me so angry. Your website said 'built to last,' and I think that {{mislead|misled}} me."
「真的很抱歉，」漢娜說，「謝謝您耐心等我調出訂單。」席爾瓦先生嘆了口氣。「我買你們的牌子買了好幾年，一直都很可靠，所以這次才這麼火大。你們的網站寫『經久耐用』，我覺得是被誤導了。」

"Do you still have the receipt?" she asked. "I must have {{misplace|misplaced}} it." "No problem. I can find the order by your email. And the {{warranty|warranty}} covers a full year, so you have two choices: a full {{refund|refund}}, or a {{replacement|replacement}}."
「您還留著收據嗎？」她問。「我一定是放到哪裡去了。」「沒關係，我可以用您的電子郵件查到訂單。而且保固期是整整一年，所以您有兩個選擇：全額退款，或是換一台新的。」

Mr. Silva was quiet for a moment. "I like that model," he said at last. "Send the new one." It arrived on Thursday. On Friday morning, he sent a short email: the coffee was hot and strong, and nothing leaked.
席爾瓦先生靜了一會兒。「我很喜歡那個型號，」他終於說，「寄新的來吧。」新機器週四送到。週五早上，他寄來一封簡短的電子郵件：咖啡又熱又濃，一滴都沒漏。
